1J22.data: Cold-rolled strip minimum induction values at room temperature, H=400..8000 A/m. Monotone linear interpolation, vacuum-slope high-field tail. No assumed temperature derating.

kede_1j21.data: Historical motor-study curve, including its assumed 5% polarization reduction. Retained explicitly for reproduction; distinct from the official 1J22 curve.

steel.data: Historical motor-study 1018 steel table; assumed material, not measured stock.

DT4.data: Historical motor-study DT4 table, including assumed polarization derating.
